newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Five reported dead in Russian plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Five reported dead in Russian plane crash.

text.p: At least five people died and 15 were injured when a Russian passenger plane crashed on landing in the Siberian town of Khanty-Mansiisk on Saturday, a spokesman for the Emergencies Ministry said.

The spokesman said the Yak-40 short-distance plane was damaged when it tried to land on the helicopter pad of the town's airport rather than on a landing strip designed for planes. It was not clear why this had happened, he said.
The spokesman said the plane, which belonged to a local airline, had up to 30 passengers and four crew on board.
